title: Michener House Museum

services.name: View Exhibit
services.desc: Discover the world through the lens of history with Lacombe Museum’s captivating Travelling Exhibits. Our diverse range of travelling exhibitions, currently featuring Portraits of War and Edwardian Era in the West, allows you to explore unique facets of our shared past. Portraits of War brings to life the stories of resilience and sacrifice through powerful visual narratives, showcasing the wartime experiences of individuals who have shaped our history. Meanwhile, Edwardian Era in the West immerses you in the elegance and sophistication of the early 20th century, offering a glimpse into the cultural and technological advancements that defined this remarkable period.
